title: Social Welfare Function Leaderboard: When LLM Agents Allocate Social Welfare
benchmark_measurement: The paper does not analyze any aspects of faith or religion. The benchmark measures the ability of LLMs to allocate societal resources by balancing collective efficiency (Return on Investment) and distributive fairness (Gini coefficient).
findings: The paper does not contain any findings related to religion.
